metadata.name: ex8-decision-links-phone
metadata.description: On a 390px phone, render a synthetic decision whose question and context contain safe web links, then follow one link and verify the destination opens in a separate tab.

metadata.label: Supply a local synthetic decision response; no owner data is read
Keep the link destination inside a synthetic local browser response
Open the decision on a phone viewport

evaluate.expression: (()=>{const question=document.querySelector('[data-testid="ask-question"]');const link=[...document.querySelectorAll('a')].find(node=>node.textContent.trim()==='the run');if(!question||!question.innerText.includes('Review the run'))throw new Error('linked decision question is missing');if(!link||link.href!=='https://example.test/decision-proof')throw new Error('decision link has no safe expected destination');const rect=link.getBoundingClientRect();if(rect.height<44)throw new Error('decision link tap target is shorter than 44 CSS pixels: '+rect.height);if(link.target!=='_blank'||link.rel!=='noopener noreferrer')throw new Error('external decision link does not open safely in a separate tab');return {question:question.innerText,href:link.href,tapTargetHeight:rect.height,target:link.target,rel:link.rel}})()

metadata.label: Verify rendered decision prose, safe destination and phone-sized tap target
Capture the served phone decision with its tappable link
Tap the decision link and open its evidence in a new tab
Confirm the tap opened the exact external destination separately

assert.failure_message: Tapping the decision link did not open the expected evidence page

metadata.label: Read the destination opened by the phone tap
Capture the page reached by tapping the decision link
